info.title: Esfera Converter API
info.description: Convert spatial audio masters to IAMF / Eclipsa from your own pipeline. `/v1` is a contract: the moment you integrate, this shape stays stable — breaking changes ship as `/v2`. Every error is an RFC 9457 problem document with a stable `type` URL (see `x-esfera-problems`). Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Optionally send `X-Esfera-Client: <name>/<version>` to label your integration in the request log.

servers.description: Production — Sandbox keys (`esf_sk_test_…`) today, Live keys (`esf_sk_live_…`) once Live opens.
Staging — Esfera's internal environment, not for partners. Staging keys don't work on production.

post.summary: Create a conversion and get an upload URL
post.description: Returns a presigned PUT URL for the master. With `preset` the job auto-starts once the upload lands (analysis still runs; it just doesn't stop to ask). Without it, call `analyze` then `start`. Always send `Idempotency-Key`: a retried create with the same key returns the first job (`duplicate: true`) and never burns a second slot or a second slice of quota. Masters over 5 GiB cannot use `uploadUrl` (storage caps a single PUT at 5 GiB): use the multipart calls. The SDK does this for any master over 16 MiB.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Any unique string per logical create. Reuse on retry.

200.description: Idempotent replay: the same job as the first call; no new upload URL.

201.description: Created. Upload the bytes to `uploadUrl` with a plain PUT and an explicit `Content-Length`.

401.description: The API key is missing, malformed, unknown, revoked, expired, or for the other environment (`invalid-api-key`).

403.description: Live only: no minutes left for this job (`quota-exhausted`). Sandbox is never metered in minutes; it refuses with `sandbox-limit` instead.

409.description: `concurrency-limit`: the team is at its limit of conversions running at once. Reserved: a create is accepted and queued whatever is already in flight, so this is not returned today. If it ever is, retry when one finishes.

422.description: Unknown `preset` (`unknown-preset`), bad `programme` (`invalid-programme`), bad or read-only `profile` (`invalid-profile`, `profile-not-writable`), bad `source.normalization` (`invalid-source-normalization`), or a source over a per-file cap (`file-too-long`, `file-too-large`).

429.description: Over 120 requests/minute for this key (`rate-limited`), or a Sandbox limit (`sandbox-limit`, with `limit` and `resets_at`). Honour `Retry-After` when it is sent; a `source_length` refusal has no reset and no `Retry-After`. The per-address limiter in front of the API can also answer 429 (`rate-limited`) before authentication: that one carries `Retry-After` but no `X-RateLimit-*` headers.

500.description: The job could not be created (`internal`).

post.x-esfera-sdk: const job = await esfera.conversions.create({ file, preset: "esfera", profile: "advanced-2" });

post.summary: Start a multipart upload of the master
post.description: For masters over 5 GiB (a single PUT caps there) and any large master, where parallel parts are faster. Every part URL is presigned up front: PUT each part's bytes to its URL (valid 1 hour), keep the `ETag` response header, then call `multipart/complete`. The conversion must still be awaiting its upload. A part must START within its URL's hour; for an upload that takes longer, get fresh URLs for the parts not yet sent with `multipart/sign`.

parameters.description: The resource id, scoped to the key's team and mode: an object from another team or the other mode answers `not-found`.

post.summary: Get fresh URLs for parts not yet uploaded
post.description: Optional. Part URLs live 1 hour and are checked when a part's PUT starts, so an upload that takes longer asks here, before a part whose URL is near its end starts (and once more if a part's PUT answers 403), for fresh URLs. How long the upload may take in all is set by the `sizeBytes` sent on create. Send the `uploadId` from `multipart/init` and up to 100 part numbers; each URL lives 1 hour, or less when the upload is near the time an unfinished upload is abandoned. A client that never calls this behaves exactly as before.

post.description: Returns the endpoint with a new `secret`, shown once. For the next 24 hours every delivery is signed with both the new secret and the one it replaced (`X-Esfera-Signature: t=<ts>,v1=<new>,v1=<old>`), so you can deploy the new secret without dropping events; afterwards only the new one signs. A receiver must accept a header with more than one `v1=` part (match any) BEFORE you rotate: a verifier that insists on exactly one part rejects deliveries during the overlap. Rotating again inside the 24 hours makes the secret being replaced the previous one and drops the oldest, so only the two most recent secrets ever sign. Send `{ "expireOldNow": true }` to skip the overlap: the old secret stops signing at once and each delivery carries one signature, made with the new secret. Use this if the old secret leaked; your receiver must switch to the new secret at once, because deliveries signed only with it are all it will get.

401.description: The API key is missing, malformed, unknown, revoked, expired, or for the other environment (`invalid-api-key`).

200.description: The OpenAPI 3.1 document for `/v1`. Cacheable for five minutes.

404.description: The v1 API is not enabled on this environment (`not-found`).

Request-Id.description: Present on every response, errors included. Quote it to support; it is also the `request_id` on any event the request caused.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests per minute allowed for this key (120). Sent only once the key has authenticated: a `401` carries none of the `X-RateLimit-*` headers.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the current window. Sent only after key auth, and omitted (with `X-RateLimit-Degraded`) when the limiter could not be reached.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix seconds when the window resets. Sent only after key auth, and omitted when `X-RateLimit-Degraded` is sent.

X-RateLimit-Degraded.description: `true` when the rate limiter was unreachable and the request was let through uncounted; `Remaining` and `Reset` are then absent. Sent only after key auth.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before retrying. Sent with `rate-limited` (and an address-level 429 before authentication) and with a `sandbox-limit` that has a reset time.

ETag.description: Entity tag of the stored output. Sent only on the output download.

Content-Range.description: `bytes start-end/total`. Sent only with a `206` on the output download.

apiKey.description: `Authorization: Bearer esf_sk_{live|test}_v1_…` — the secret shown once at key creation. Header only, never a query string. The loggable key id is the `esf_k_…` prefix. Production accepts Sandbox keys (`esf_sk_test_…`) today and Live keys (`esf_sk_live_…`) once Live opens. A key belongs to a team and a mode, and a Sandbox key only sees Sandbox objects. A team can have 5 active keys in each mode. Staging is Esfera's internal environment; its keys don't work on production. A revoked key stops working within 10 seconds.

Conversion.description: A conversion job and, once `ready`, its output.

mode.description: The mode of the key that made it. A Sandbox (`esf_sk_test_…`) key only ever sees Sandbox objects, a Live key only Live ones.

name.description: The filename you gave at create.

objectCount.description: Discrete objects found in the source.

outputLoudnessLufs.description: Integrated loudness of the output on the 7.1.4 bus (ITU-R BS.1770).

programmeCount.description: Programmes the ADM declares; null until analysed.

preset.description: The chosen preset; null until chosen.

programme.description: 0-based programme index; null when the file has one programme.

expiresAt.description: When the output is swept (24 h after it finished in Sandbox, 72 h in Live).

profile.description: The profile you asked for; `auto` when you left it to the preset.

outputProfile.description: The profile the written file declares; null until `ready`.

output.description: What the written file holds; null until `ready`.

Source.description: What the source file is. `adm`, or `ambisonic` (a bare AmbiX/FuMa WAV, 1OA–3OA).

note.description: The probe's doubt for 4-channel files (first-order ambisonic or quad); always present, `null` for ADM sources.

Output.description: What the written file holds, once `ready`: its profile, the IAMF audio elements and mix presentations the encoder wrote, and how many source objects were folded into a bed or scene rather than kept as their own element.

profile.description: The profile the written file declares.

foldedObjects.description: Source objects folded into a bed or scene instead of kept discrete.

layout.description: Loudspeaker layout of a bed (`7.1.4`) or the order of a scene (`3OA`); null for an object.

language.description: BCP 47 tag; null when the master did not say.

durationSec.description: Source duration. In Live it reserves minutes up front. Longest accepted: 10 minutes in Sandbox (longer is refused with `sandbox-limit`), 180 minutes per file in Live.

sizeBytes.description: Source size in bytes. Optional, but send it: a source over 107374182400 bytes is refused here (`file-too-large`) instead of failing after the upload. It also extends how long an unfinished upload is kept, by the time the size takes at 2 Mbit/s (up to seven days in all): send it for any upload that may be slow.

preset.description: Supply to auto-start once the upload lands. Omit for the two-step flow. A preset the analysed source cannot take (the 3OA scene presets for a 1OA/2OA ambisonic file) fails the conversion after analysis with that reason, as does a preset whose plan is over its profile budget for the master or whose render would not fit in the converter's memory.

programme.description: 0-based programme to convert when the ADM declares several.

source.description: Ambisonic sources only. Default sn3d (AmbiX). fuma is first order only.

profile.description: IAMF profile to declare. `auto` lets the preset decide. Ids from GET /v1/presets; a listed-but-unwritable id is refused.

uploadUrl.description: Presigned PUT URL. Send the raw bytes with `Content-Length`; no auth header.

autoStart.description: True when `preset` was given: the encode starts itself after analysis.

programme.description: 0-based. Required when the file declares several programmes.

source.description: Ambisonic sources only. Default sn3d (AmbiX). fuma is first order only.

profile.description: Overrides a profile given at create; `auto` clears it; omit to keep it.

ListEnvelope.description: What every list returns. Each list narrows `data` to its own item type; page-style reads of conversions and deliveries also carry their older keys until v2.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `starting_after` for the next page; null on the last page.
Pass as `starting_after` for the next page; null on the last page.

items.description: Deprecated: the same array as `data`, kept until v2.

parts.description: How many parts the master is split into.

url.description: Presigned PUT URL for this part; a PUT must start within 1 hour (fresh ones: `multipart/sign`).

partNumbers.description: The parts to sign afresh: ones not uploaded yet.

etag.description: The `ETag` response header from that part's PUT.

mode.description: The mode of the key that registered it. It receives events only for that mode's conversions.

events.description: The event types delivered to this endpoint.

description.description: Free text you set with PATCH.

url.description: https only; no localhost or private ranges.

events.description: The event types to receive. Defaults to all seven.

description.description: Free text to tell endpoints apart. Empty means none.

url.description: https only; no localhost or private ranges.

expireOldNow.description: Stop the old secret signing immediately instead of after 24 hours.

secret.description: `whsec_esf_…` — the new secret, shown once. The replaced one also signs for 24 hours.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `starting_after` for the next page; null on the last page.

webhooks.description: Deprecated: the same array as `data`, kept until v2.

conversionId.description: Null once the conversion is deleted; the delivery outlives it.

attempts.description: Whole-lifetime attempt count; replays keep counting.

lastStatus.description: HTTP status your endpoint last returned.

lastResponseBody.description: The first 4 KB of what your endpoint answered, as text. A non-text body reads `[binary N bytes]`; a cut one ends with `[truncated]`.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `starting_after` for the next page; null on the last page.

deliveries.description: Deprecated: the same array as `data`, kept until v2.

objects.description: Whether the profile carries discrete objects.

writable.description: Whether this encoder will declare it. Base-Advanced is read but not written.

declares.description: What the preset declares when you pass no `profile`. Several means the encoder picks by content (Esfera: Base-Enhanced for a bed-only master, Advanced-1 with objects within 18 elements / 18 channels, Advanced-2 above). `outputProfile` on the conversion is the per-job answer.

objects.description: What happens to the master's objects.

Usage.description: The key's team and mode. Sandbox is metered in conversions, not minutes: `plan` is `sandbox`, every `minutes` field is 0 except `used` (today's Sandbox source minutes), and `sandbox` carries the allowance.

mode.description: The mode of the key that made it. A Sandbox (`esf_sk_test_…`) key only ever sees Sandbox objects, a Live key only Live ones.

sandbox.description: Sandbox only (null in Live): the allowance and where the team stands today (UTC).

conversionsToday.description: Conversions created today (UTC), deleted and failed ones included. A batch of N files counts N.

inFlight.description: Sandbox conversions queued or running, against `limits.concurrent` (1). Uploads and analyses don't count.

resetsAt.description: Sandbox: the next UTC midnight, when `conversionsToday` starts again from 0.
Live: the first instant of the next calendar month (UTC), when the allowance refills; null for a one-time grant. In Sandbox this is the next UTC midnight, when the daily conversion count resets.

remaining.description: What a job may still cost: plan remaining plus purchased credit.

perFileMinutes.description: Longest source accepted, in minutes: 10 in Sandbox, 180 otherwise.

inFlight.description: Conversions not yet finished: uploading, analysing, analysed, queued or running. Only queued and running ones hold a concurrency slot; `concurrent` bounds those. Uploads and analyses don't hold one.

retentionHours.description: Hours an output is kept after it finishes: 24 in Sandbox, 72 in Live.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem document. `type` is stable; match on it, not on `title`.

SandboxLimitProblem.description: The `sandbox-limit` problem: which Sandbox limit was hit and when it resets.

limit.description: `source_length`: the source is over 10 minutes. `daily_conversions`: the team has made 25 Sandbox conversions today (UTC).

resets_at.description: When the limit resets (the next UTC midnight); null for `source_length`, which never resets.

Event.description: Something that happened to a conversion. GET /v1/events returns these, and a webhook delivers exactly this document. `event`, `createdAt` and `data.conversion` are the pre-events webhook fields (the same values as `type`, `created` and `data.object`), kept until v2.

mode.description: The mode of the key that made it. A Sandbox (`esf_sk_test_…`) key only ever sees Sandbox objects, a Live key only Live ones.

request_id.description: The `Request-Id` of the API request that caused it; null when nothing you sent did (the encode finishing, retention).

object.description: The conversion as it was at that moment.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `starting_after` for the next page; null on the last page.

post.summary: A conversion was created (`POST /v1/conversions`); upload the master next.

parameters.name: X-Esfera-Signature
parameters.description: `t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of "<t>.<raw body>" with your endpoint's secret>`. Reject when |now − t| > 300 s. Compare in constant time. For 24 hours after a secret rotation the header carries two `v1=` parts (`t=<ts>,v1=<new>,v1=<old>`): accept the delivery when any part matches.

2xx.description: Acknowledged. Anything else is retried with backoff (8 attempts); deliveries are at-least-once — dedupe on the event `id`.

post.summary: Analysis finished; the conversion is `analyzed` (two-step flow) or about to start (auto-start). Sent again after a re-analysis.

invalid-request.summary: A required field is missing or malformed. Fix the request body.

invalid-api-key.summary: The key is missing, malformed, unknown, revoked, expired, or for the other environment. Check the Authorization header and which host you are calling.

quota-exhausted.summary: Live only: this team has no conversion minutes left for this job. Top up or wait for the monthly reset. Sandbox is never metered in minutes; it refuses with sandbox-limit instead.

team-not-approved.summary: This team hasn't been approved for API access yet. Request access in the console.

mode-mismatch.summary: Internal log reason: a key touched an object from the other mode. Clients receive not-found, never this type.

not-found.summary: No such resource for this team in this mode. Ids belong to one team and one mode.

concurrency-limit.summary: The team is at its limit of conversions running at once. Reserved: creates are queued rather than refused today, so this is not returned. Retry when one finishes.

already-started.summary: The conversion is past the state this call applies to. Read its status first.

programme-required.summary: The file declares several programmes. Pass `programme` (0-based) on start.

source-removed.summary: The source was removed by retention. Upload it again.

webhook-limit.summary: This team is at its active-endpoint cap in this mode. Revoke one first.

replay-in-flight.summary: This delivery is already queued or retrying. Wait for it to settle.

unknown-preset.summary: `preset` is not one of the ids GET /v1/presets lists.

invalid-programme.summary: `programme` must be a non-negative integer (0-based) within the file's programme count.

invalid-source-normalization.summary: `source.normalization` must be sn3d, n3d or fuma; fuma is first order only; it applies to ambisonic sources only.

preset-not-for-source.summary: This preset cannot take this source yet (a first- or second-order ambisonic source into the 3OA scene presets). Use esfera or youtube, or a third-order source.

invalid-profile.summary: `profile` must be a profile id from GET /v1/presets, or "auto".

profile-not-writable.summary: This encoder reads that profile but will not declare it. Pick a writable one.

preset-over-cap.summary: This preset's plan exceeds its IAMF profile budget for this master; the analysis says why. Pick a preset the analysis marks as fitting.

file-too-long.summary: The source exceeds the per-file duration cap. Split it.

file-too-large.summary: The source exceeds the per-file size cap (bytes). Fewer channels or a shorter master.

invalid-multipart.summary: `parts` must be an integer from 1 to 10000; `uploadId` and `parts` are required on complete; on sign, `partNumbers` are 1 to 100 distinct part numbers and `uploadId` must be the upload init started.

invalid-webhook-url.summary: The endpoint URL is not allowed (https only, no private hosts).

sandbox-limit.summary: The sandbox allowance for this team is used up. Wait for it to reset, or ask for live access.

rate-limited.summary: Too many requests for this key. Honour Retry-After.

internal.summary: Something failed on our side. Retry; if it persists, contact support with the conversion id.

upload-failed.summary: Storage refused to finalise the upload; retry the upload from the start.

queue-unavailable.summary: The delivery queue is not configured on this environment.

queue-send-failed.summary: The delivery queue did not accept the replay. Try again shortly.
